protocol.architecture: Existing LQR plus categorical PPO residual with predictive supervisor; not full-command switching

one_predefined_variant.prediction: Nominal linear bicycle, physical actuator lag/rate, observable curvature preview, repeated current residual and causal filter state. Continued healthy service is a performance-model assumption, never a policy input or safety guarantee.

protocol.reward: -(executed_ey/0.5)^2 -0.2*(executed_heading/0.1)^2 -0.2*(actual_actuator_rate/0.35)^2 -0.005*(command/0.5)^2 -10*failure; no future output or exogenous delay penalty

training.initialization: original frozen causal student; extra pretraining disclosed
training.futility: If <=0.1% of first10000 executed transitions have actual nonzero assistance, stop this seed before100k; preserve failed gate/training result; no alternate controller or tuning

development.if_futility: Report stopped seeds and evaluate initial/reference/frozen10000 checkpoints descriptively; stopped endpoint is ineligible; never silently substitute it as100k

protocol.acceptance: Same prior scientific screen: PPO penalized lateral RMSE >=1% better than matched LQR, same-supervisor student and BOTH fixed corrections; all3 paired student gains positive; no survival loss; nominal <=1.02LQR; overall headingRMSE and actuatorRateRMS <=1.05LQR; exact100ms fallback. Final100k endpoints only. No per-seed/cherry-picked checkpoint selection.

timing.cpus: highest available local CPU; next highest for worker and generated stress; neither excludes host tasks
timing.controller: old age_filtered diagnostic and old25k PPO export, for attribution separate from new training
timing.criterion: Any original10ms deadline miss fails observed timing; no rebasing/forgiveness. Pure native spin deliberately consumes one CPU; cloud-only diagnosis, not portable laptop default or hard real-time guarantee.

protocol.confirmation: Only if all3 final100k endpoints pass development AND corresponding selected-controller real-worker timing is separately frozen and passes, freeze unopened confirmation before running it. Old reserved data remain unopened on failure.
protocol.stop: One controller/reward variant, exactly3 finite pilots or prespecified futility; all outcomes published; no outcome-driven extra training, threshold changes or new variants. Native selected-winner confirmation conditional on eligibility. Target laptop/physical vehicle cannot be executed remotely without connected hardware. Full published robust-algorithm/bibliographic verification must not be marked complete without evidence.
